title.zh: 遗产税（已故者 Xu Chue Fern 的遗产）（减免）命令 2001
title.en: Estate Duty (Xu Chue Fern, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2001

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Xu Chue Fern, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2001.

2. The sum of $15,708.08 payable under the Act on the share in the Estate of Oey Siok Lian, Deceased, and the Estate of Koh Peng Yam, Deceased, passing on the death of Xu Chue Fern on 19th December 1997 is hereby remitted.
